_comment: Path D allowlist. Normal (non-owner) callers of Buddy model selection only ever receive targets listed here. Every entry MUST cite Path A benchmark evidence (a live_benchmark_ok slot with provider+model id, fixture hash, response hash, latency, cost, grader version, UTC timestamp) or Path B adapter evidence (the backing connector in config/buddy-model-router.json is local_ready or adapter_implemented and its adapter passes sandbox tests). Being listed is NOT a live or quality claim: readiness, per-request paid approval, and providerCallExecuted=false still apply. Add entries only by reviewed PR.

evidence_paths.A: Path A benchmark evidence: live_benchmark_ok slot in config/buddy/500-model-registry.json with full signed evidence.
evidence_paths.B: Path B adapter evidence: backing connector implementation_status is local_ready or adapter_implemented in config/buddy-model-router.json.
